events.name: Tick
events.description: The Interval has elapsed. It repeats while Enabled is true.
events.useCase: Update a clock, poll a status or auto-save.

events.name: DoWork
events.description: RunWorkerAsync was called. This runs on a background thread, so it must not touch controls.
events.useCase: Do the long task, such as processing files.

events.name: ProgressChanged
events.description: ReportProgress was called. This runs on the UI thread, so it may update controls.

events.name: RunWorkerCompleted
events.description: The work finished, failed or was cancelled. This runs on the UI thread.
events.useCase: Show the result or the error.

events.name: MouseClick
events.description: The user clicks the tray icon.
events.useCase: Restore the window when the user left-clicks the icon.

events.name: MouseDoubleClick
events.description: The user double-clicks the tray icon.

events.name: BalloonTipClicked
events.description: The user clicks the balloon shown with ShowBalloonTip.
events.useCase: Open the item the notification is about.

events.name: BalloonTipClosed
